BENGALURU, FRIDAY, 23, FEBRUARY, 2024(PHALGUNA, 04, SHAKAVARSHA, 1945) Volume - 159 Issue 42

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RC- CFS/58/2024-RC Karnataka Government Secretariat
E-1314502 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru 560-001, Date: 12-02-2024

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Talakere Village of Turuvekere Taluk, Tumkur
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Hiredonkihalli and
Puttamadihalli as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers
and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD.62GLH 2023 Dated 24-02-2023
regarding altering the limits of Kambagi village of Babaleshwar Taluk and Vijayapur
District and constituting a new revenue village called Hanamasagar was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD.62.GLH2023 (Part 4A) Dated 06-03-2023
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Vijayapur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 07-03-2023 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Babaleshwar taluk Vijayapur District to form a new revenue village called as
Hanamasagar of Babaleshwar taluk Vijayapur District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Hadalasang Village of Indi taluk Vijayapur District
and to constitute a new revenue village called Pandu Nagar, Roopa Nagar, Balaji
Nagar and Sri Ram Nagar as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Vijayapur District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Hadalasang of Indi taluk VijayapurDistrict to form a new revenue village called
Pandu Nagar of Indi taluk Vijayapur district along with the survey numbers included
in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD110 GLH 2022 Dated:13-10-2022
regarding altering the limits of Sasvigera village of Devdurga Taluk and Raichur
District and constituting a new revenue village called NarayanNayak Nagar,
Karimaradi, Dhanasingh Nayak Nagar was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette RD 110 GLH 2021 dated:13-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from
all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Raichur
district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:15-10-2022 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Sasvigera village of Devdurga Taluk and Raichur District to form a new
revenue village called as Narayan Nayak Nagar of Devdurga Taluk and Raichur
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 1021KAMGRARA2017,
BANGALURU Dated 11-01-2015 regarding altering the limits of MARTALLI village
of Hannur Taluk and Chamarajnagar District and constituting a new revenue village
called VADDARADODDI AND NALROAD was published as required by section 6 of
the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette No. Part-IV-A dated:26/04/2018 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Chamarajnagar district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 26.04.2018 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village village of Hannur Taluk in Chamarajnagar District to form a new revenue village
called as VADDARADODDI of Hannur Taluk Chamarajnagar District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Neeralakatti Village of Shiggaon Taluk, Haveri
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Shivajipura as specified
in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Haveri District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of
Neeralakatti village of Shiggaon taluk Haveri district to form a new revenue village
called as Shivajipura of Shiggaon taluk and Haveri district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Ragikoppa Village of shikaripura taluk Shivamogga
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Ragikoppa Thanda as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Shivamogga
District.

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said

village called Ragikoppa Thanda of Shikaripura Taluk Shivamogga District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) there of.
